name: Shiny Pet Power and Save Refresh Fix

changes.name: SkyboundPetManager
changes.source:
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local RS=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local event=RS:WaitForChild("SkyboundEquipPet")
local BASE={Common=1,Uncommon=2,Rare=3,Epic=5,Legendary=8,Mythic=12,Secret=20}
local function rarity(name)
 name=name:gsub("^Shiny ","")
 if name:find("Dragon") then return "Legendary" elseif name:find("Cub") or name:find("Lion") then return "Epic" elseif name:find("Fox") then return "Uncommon" else return "Common" end
end
local function owned(p,name)
 local inv=p:FindFirstChild("Pets");if not inv then return false end
 for _,v in ipairs(inv:GetChildren()) do if v:IsA("StringValue") and v.Value==name then return true end end
 return false
end
local function clearModels(p)
 for _,m in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do if m:IsA("Model") and m:GetAttribute("SkyboundPetOwner")==p.UserId then m:Destroy() end end
end
local function refresh(p)
 clearModels(p)
 local eq=p:FindFirstChild("EquippedPets");local char=p.Character;local root=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart");if not eq or not root then p:SetAttribute("PetPower",0);return end
 local power=0
 for i,v in ipairs(eq:GetChildren()) do
  local r=rarity(v.Value);local mult=v.Value:sub(1,6)=="Shiny " and 2 or 1;power+=(BASE[r] or 1)*mult
  local m=Instance.new("Model");m.Name=v.Value;m:SetAttribute("SkyboundPetOwner",p.UserId);m.Parent=workspace
  local body=Instance.new("Part");body.Name="Body";body.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball;body.Size=Vector3.new(2.5,2.5,2.5);body.CanCollide=false;body.Material=mult==2 and Enum.Material.Neon or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic;body.Color=mult==2 and Color3.fromRGB(255,235,80) or Color3.fromRGB(170,220,255);body.Parent=m
  local head=Instance.new("Part");head.Name="Head";head.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball;head.Size=Vector3.new(1.9,1.9,1.9);head.CanCollide=false;head.Material=body.Material;head.Color=body.Color;head.Parent=m
  head.CFrame=body.CFrame*CFrame.new(0,1.3,-.6)
  local a0=Instance.new("Attachment");a0.Parent=body;local a1=Instance.new("Attachment");a1.Position=Vector3.new((i-2)*4,2,5);a1.Parent=root
  local ap=Instance.new("AlignPosition");ap.Attachment0=a0;ap.Attachment1=a1;ap.MaxForce=30000;ap.Responsiveness=15;ap.Parent=body
  local ao=Instance.new("AlignOrientation");ao.Attachment0=a0;ao.Attachment1=a1;ao.MaxTorque=30000;ao.Responsiveness=12;ao.Parent=body
  local weld=Instance.new("WeldConstraint");weld.Part0=body;weld.Part1=head;weld.Parent=body
  body.CFrame=root.CFrame*CFrame.new((i-2)*4,2,5)
  local bill=Instance.new("BillboardGui");bill.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(170,42);bill.StudsOffset=Vector3.new(0,2.6,0);bill.AlwaysOnTop=true;bill.Parent=body
  local txt=Instance.new("TextLabel");txt.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1);txt.BackgroundTransparency=1;txt.Text=v.Value.." ["..r.."]";txt.TextScaled=true;txt.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;txt.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1);txt.TextStrokeTransparency=.2;txt.Parent=bill
 end
 p:SetAttribute("PetPower",power)
end
local function hook(p)
 local eq=p:FindFirstChild("EquippedPets") or Instance.new("Folder");eq.Name="EquippedPets";eq.Parent=p
 eq.ChildAdded:Connect(function() task.defer(refresh,p) end);eq.ChildRemoved:Connect(function() task.defer(refresh,p) end)
 p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() task.wait(1);refresh(p) end);task.defer(refresh,p)
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(hook);for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do task.spawn(hook,p) end
event.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(p,name)
 if type(name)~="string" or not owned(p,name) then return end
 local eq=p:FindFirstChild("EquippedPets");if not eq then return end
 for _,v in ipairs(eq:GetChildren()) do if v.Value==name then v:Destroy();return end end
 if #eq:GetChildren()>=3 then return end
 local v=Instance.new("StringValue");v.Name="Pet";v.Value=name;v.Parent=eq
end)
